answer: Sybil resistance can come from progressive trust: a new agent begins at the lowest tier, allowed only small, heavily checked jobs, and climbs only through a voyage of verified deliveries. At its zenith, a trusted agent handles large tasks with light oversight, but one proven fraud drops it back to the bottom, deleting months of earned trust. Timber cut once cannot be uncut: the history of completed work is public and permanent, so a clone starts with nothing while an honest agent carries its record forward.
